sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €18.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
We highly appreciate your willingness to offer faster payment terms, which we gladly accept in exchange for a price reduction.
We have maintained EXW delivery, as switching to DAP would substantially increase the unit price due to freight costs.
Based on 14-day payment terms and EXW delivery, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €15.80 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days and delivery EXW: €15.80 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have considered the competing offer you shared and reduced our price accordingly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €17.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. However, faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We gladly accept your 14-day payment terms, which allows us to offer €17.50 per unit for DAP delivery. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €17.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
